L3682@P59: Bacto Casitone is a pancreatic digest of casein. The
L3683@P59: manufacturing process for an enzymatic digest of
L3684@P59: casein is not as destructive as an acid hydrolysis. Thus,
L3685@P59: the casein is not broken down as completely into its
L3686@P59: constituent components. In many cases, this makes
L3687@P59: for a more nutritious hydrolysate, especially for those
L3688@P59: organisms that prefer peptides to amino acids.
L3689@P59: Difco Tryptone is a pancreatic digest of casein
L3690@P59: and is the primary nitrogen source in trypticase soy
L3691@P59: broth and agar.
L3692@P59: Bacto Tryptone is a pancreatic digest of casein. It was
L3693@P59: developed while investigating a peptone particularly
L3694@P59: suitable for the elaboration of indole by bacteria.
L3695@P59: BiTek Tryptone is prepared similarly to Bacto Tryptone,
L3696@P59: but the final product goes through fewer refinement steps
L3697@P59: during processing.

L3037@P49: Product description
L3038@P49: Bacto Proteose Peptones are enzymatic digests of
L3039@P49: protein. Studies of peptic digests of animal tissue
L3040@P49: prepared under varying digestion parameters
L3041@P49: demonstrated that no single peptone is the most suitable
L3042@P49: nitrogen source for every microbiological application.
L3043@P49: These findings led to the development of Bacto Proteose
L3044@P49: Peptone, Bacto Proteose Peptone No. 2, and Bacto
L3045@P49: Proteose Peptone No. 3. Bacto Proteose Peptone No. 4
L3046@P49: is a spray-dried version of Bacto Proteose Peptone.
L3047@P49: BiTek Proteose Peptone and BiTek Proteose Peptone
L3048@P49: No. 3 are enzymatic digests of protein, developed to offer
L3049@P49: alternatives to Bacto Proteose Peptones for scale-up to
L3050@P49: production applications.
L3051@P49: Potential applications
L3052@P49: Bacto Proteose Peptone is used in preparing
L3053@P49: microbiological culture media and in producing bacterial
L3054@P49: toxins. Bacto Proteose Peptone was originally developed
L3055@P49: to produce a diphtheria toxin of high and uniform
L3056@P49: potency from cultures of Corynebacterium diphtheriae.
L3057@P49: Studies support the use of Bacto Proteose Peptone for
